name: Jhalkari Bai
role: Woman warrior associated with Jhansi defense
contribution: Jhalkari Bai is associated with the defense of Jhansi during the 1857 rebellion and is remembered in later accounts as a woman warrior who served alongside Rani Lakshmibai.
context: Her story sits at the intersection of the Jhansi resistance, women's military participation, and later community-based memory. Some details of her life vary across historical and commemorative accounts.
impact: Jhalkari Bai's memory expands the history of 1857 beyond royal and male commanders and reflects the ways later communities recovered women's roles in anti-colonial resistance.
highlight: Woman warrior associated with the defense of Jhansi in 1857.
